defect: The fix replaces the existing stripPrefix calls with fsspec's _strip_protocol for filesystems with custom protocol handling.
reason: The change only reformatted the open call; stripPrefix was already used before it, so the fixed behaviour predates this change.

defect: The fix removes a double i-- after erasing from both filters and pushdown_results.
reason: This change has a single correct erase_at(i--); the second erase with another i-- was added later by 242e1a08023.

defect: StringValue::Get(dummy_val) is called even when the header value is NULL, and it throws an InternalException on NULL values.
reason: The change added the StringValue::Get call next to dummy_val.IsNull(), and the fix only calls Get when the value is not NULL.

defect: initial_format_candidates compares against the template count although the re-enabled ISO filter removes entries, so the reset never fires for '-' separators, and the new reset branch returns without clearing the date format.
reason: Both the size comparison and the reset branch were added by this change, and the fix compares against the original candidate list and sets the empty format in that branch.

defect: The fix passes an explicit schema to Table.from_batches so empty results convert to Arrow.
reason: from_batches was already called without a schema before this change, so empty results already failed; the change only moved schema creation into the loop.

defect: The fix adds per-renderer value conversion (markdown pipe escaping, box truncation) and changes the ConvertColumnarResult signature.
reason: Markdown escaping never existed before this change; the header edit only renamed declarations, so the fix is a new feature and refactor.

defect: HandleText calls max_length.GetIndex() when no max_length is set, and that throws an InternalException for every prompt without max_length.
reason: HandleText was added by this change, and the fix returns the text early when max_length is invalid.

defect: The new FK binding resolves referenced columns without checking that a PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE index exists on them, so such foreign keys are accepted and then not verified correctly.
reason: The FK resolution code was added by this 'implement FK' change, and the fix (#3352) adds the missing index check there.

defect: The fix removes an or_zone_map variable that became unused and reformats a long signature (clang-tidy and format).
reason: In this change or_zone_map was used; a5b552e removed its use later, and the long line is only formatting.

defect: The fix deletes the new interrupt test because it seemed to cause memory leaks in CI.
reason: The fix is a test removal (a partial revert of a test), not a repair of product code that this change introduced.

defect: std::move(sel_entry->Copy()) moves a temporary, which triggers clang's pessimizing-move warning and breaks the macOS build with warnings as errors.
reason: The line was added by this change, and the fix drops the redundant std::move to repair the OSX build.

defect: The fix adapts to the API change from prepared_statement.plan to physical_plan after a merge.
reason: The code was correct against the API at the time; the fix is a merge adaptation.

defect: The fix removes an unused variable left behind when a D_ASSERT replaced the throw.
reason: In this change the variable was used by the throw; a1e21c97964 turned it into a D_ASSERT and made it unused in release builds.

defect: The fix moves json_pretty_print to its alphabetical position in the generated list.
reason: The lookup is a linear scan, so the order does not affect behaviour; this is a cosmetic or generated-file consistency fix.

defect: The fix renames the static exception variable and adds a NOLINT for lint rules.
reason: This is a lint and style change with no behavioural defect.

defect: The new assertions require the heap offset to be > 0, but the first entry has offset 0, so they fire on valid data in debug builds.
reason: The assertions were added by this change, and the fix relaxes them to >= 0.

defect: The fix mostly reformats the new index join code and newly disables index joins when enable_optimizer is false.
reason: Index joins ignored enable_optimizer before this change too, the swap fixes had already landed in 4a10ba5, and the rest is formatting.

defect: The fix adds a get_lock flag to Scan to avoid taking the segment's shared lock twice when FilterScan or Select call it.
reason: At this change FilterScan was a stub and did not call Scan under the lock; the recursive locking came with 7d7a85fb.

defect: The fix avoids taking the shared lock twice when FilterScan or Select call Scan while already holding it.
reason: This change called Scan outside the lock; the double lock was introduced by 7d7a85fb, which moved the lock before the version check.

defect: Replacing the subquery-parameter binding path with an unconditional BinderException broke python_map, which binds its table argument through that path.
reason: This change removed the path, and the fix restores it for functions whose first argument is TABLE.

defect: The fix renames the duckdb_logs named parameter join_contexts to denormalized_table.
reason: join_contexts was a valid parameter at this change; the fix is a consistent API rename and cleanup.

defect: The fix erases the child before shrinking a Node16 to Node4, so the erased child is not copied into the new node.
reason: The shrink branch already copied all children without erasing pos before this change; the change only fixed the count > 3 branch.

defect: The fix addresses clang-tidy findings: redundant std::move on a trivially copyable struct, and bzero replaced by memset.
reason: These are style and lint changes; bzero was already present before this change.

defect: The fix drops the Count() >= 1024 threshold and always initializes the bloom filter, while fixing constant-vector hashing in the filter.
reason: The threshold looks like a workaround that the real constant-hash fix made unnecessary; the repaired defect lies in bloom_filter.hpp, not in this gating.

defect: Hashing a constant key vector gives a constant hash vector that LookupHashes then reads as a flat array.
reason: The unselected path's Hash(keys_v, hashes_v) call was unchanged from before this change, and the new selection path flattens the keys, so the constant-vector bug is older.

defect: Changing Relation::context to shared_ptr<ClientContextWrapper> (with a polymorphic base that has no virtual destructor) broke the Python package, which still used rel->context.TryGetContext().
reason: The fix 'Fix python build' adapts pyrelation.cpp to the pointer and adds the virtual destructor, repairing a compile failure caused by this interface change.

defect: The fix changes rel->context.TryGetContext() to rel->context->TryGetContext() after context became a shared_ptr.
reason: The line was correct when written; 368756e changed the member type 128 days later and broke it.

defect: The fix regenerates the header with wrapped lines and documentation for duckdb_append_default_to_chunk.
reason: This is header-generation formatting and documentation, not a behavioural defect.

defect: ParseRangeVar assigns the raw input instead of the parsed entry when no schema is given, so a quoted name keeps its quotes.
reason: ParseRangeVar was added by this change, and the fix changes name = input to name = entry.

defect: The regenerated list registers ListSliceFun and ArraySliceFun as single functions with GetFunction(), but array_slice.cpp defines GetFunctions() returning a set, so the build fails.
reason: The wrong macros came from this generation change, and the fix restores the SET variants.

defect: The fix only wraps the long LocalAppend declaration.
reason: This is a formatting change in this file.

defect: The fix regenerates the extension entries, adding ducklake functions and a secret type and reflowing the list.
reason: This updates generated data for new extension entries; nothing this change added was wrong.

defect: The fix frees the script buffer and disconnects before failing the test runner, to avoid leaks.
reason: The leaks on REQUIRE(false) paths already existed in the test harness; this is test-infrastructure cleanup.

defect: The bloom filter is pushed when join_condition has one entry even if the hash table has several key conditions, and it ignores NOT DISTINCT FROM null semantics, so probe rows can be filtered wrongly.
reason: The bloom filter pushdown was added by this change, and the fix checks ht->conditions.size() and passes FiltersNullValues.

defect: The new constant-NULL ARRAY fast path in Flatten only invalidates the parent and the immediate child and returns, leaving the flattened child (and nested children) inconsistent.
reason: The fast path was added by this change, and the fix removes it as the 'wrong path'.

defect: The fix turns the GetChildStats debug assertion into an InternalException for safety against stats type mismatches.
reason: This is hardening of an assertion; the real bug (#6656, missing casts in list_concat) is elsewhere and predates this change.

defect: CreateNode calls GetMetricAsString(OPERATOR_TYPE) for the root node, but the same change erases OPERATOR_TYPE from the root's settings, so it throws 'Metric not enabled'.
reason: Both the erase and the call were added by this change, and the fix reads the operator type only for depth > 0.

defect: The fix re-enables the random/aggregates SQLite logic tests and excludes specific files.
reason: This is a test configuration change; the product fix is elsewhere.

defect: The union tag is read as int8_t although tags are uint8_t, so tags of 128 and above become negative and never match their member index.
reason: CreateValuesUnion was added by this change, and the fix reads the tag as uint8_t.

defect: The fix guards the non-object Transform path against an empty result_vectors list (for example count(*)), which would otherwise index result_vectors[0].
reason: In this change result_vectors always held every output column; it can only be empty since 00afb6bd filtered it by valid_cols.
